Shapes and Sizes | Shapes and Sizes are a Canadian indie rock band from Victoria, British Columbia.  There are four members — Nathan Gage, Caila Thompson-Hannant, Rory Seydel and John Crellin.  After self-releasing their self-titled first album in early 2006, the band caught the attention of Sufjan Stevens' record label Asthmatic Kitty who later reissued the album in July 2006.  They are the only Canadian band to be signed to Asthmatic Kitty.
